retirement_age.notes: General retirement age for government employees (raised from 57 to 59 in 2011). A higher age applies to freedom fighters; sources differ (60 in a 2012 change per one reference, 61 per a 2024 policy article). In 2024 the interim government was reported to be considering raising the general age to 61; no such change was confirmed. No statutory retirement age for elected or senior political office was found.

open_questions: Office holders changed in 2026: Tarique Rahman became Prime Minister on 2026-02-17 after the 2026-02-12 election; President Mohammed Shahabuddin resigned (acting president Hafiz Uddin Ahmad from 2026-07-24) and Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was sworn in on 2026-08-21.
Date of the next general election not found; set to null.
Term end dates for the President and the Prime Minister were not confirmed from an official source; set to null.
Retirement age: the 59-year figure comes from sources dated 2024-2025; whether the new government changed it in 2026 was not verified. The freedom fighter age (60 or 61) is unresolved.
Median age: no clearly dated UN/national figure was found in this run; left null.
Population: 176 million (2025) is the UN World Population Prospects 2024 figure as rounded to millions by INED. The 2022 census result was about 169.8 million, so figures differ by source.
